title: Hortatory Exposition
goals: memahami tujuan **hortatory exposition**: meyakinkan pembaca bahwa suatu hal **seharusnya** atau **tidak seharusnya** dilakukan (*ought to be the case*)
memakai modal [[should]], [[must]], [[ought to]], [[had better]] untuk saran dan ajakan
memakai ungkapan saran: [[I suggest that ...]], [[It is important to ...]], [[Let's ...]]
menulis teks hortatory singkat yang meyakinkan

lesson.text: Di unit 36 kamu belajar meyakinkan pembaca bahwa sesuatu **memang demikian**. Sekarang kamu meyakinkan pembaca untuk **bertindak**: kita *seharusnya* menghemat air, *seharusnya* tidak membuang sampah sembarangan. Itulah **hortatory exposition**, teks yang sering dipakai dalam kampanye, pidato, dan opini.

lesson.title: Setelah suggest
lesson.text: Setelah [[I suggest that]], kata kerja memakai **bentuk dasar**, tanpa -s: [[I suggest that he **study** harder.]] (bukan *studies*). Setelah [[should]] dan [[must]] pun kata kerja bentuk dasar.

lesson.title: Teks 1: Let's Keep Our River Clean

lines.en: Rivers are important for our lives, so we should keep them clean. Today, many rivers are full of rubbish.
lines.id: Sungai penting bagi hidup kita, jadi kita seharusnya menjaganya tetap bersih. Kini banyak sungai penuh sampah.

lines.en: Firstly, dirty water makes people sick. Secondly, rubbish blocks the water and can cause floods. Moreover, fish and other animals die because of the pollution.
lines.id: Pertama, air kotor membuat orang sakit. Kedua, sampah menyumbat air dan dapat menyebabkan banjir. Selain itu, ikan dan hewan lain mati karena pencemaran.

lines.en: Therefore, we must not throw rubbish into the river. I suggest that every family put its rubbish in a bin. Let's also clean the river together every month.
lines.id: Oleh karena itu, kita tidak boleh membuang sampah ke sungai. Saya menyarankan setiap keluarga membuang sampah ke tempat sampah. Mari juga membersihkan sungai bersama setiap bulan.

lines.en: Our school should have a plastic-free campaign.
lines.id: Sekolah kita seharusnya punya kampanye bebas plastik.

lines.en: Why? Is plastic really a problem?
Yes. Plastic takes hundreds of years to decay and it harms sea animals.
lines.id: Ya. Plastik butuh ratusan tahun untuk terurai dan membahayakan hewan laut.

lines.en: I see. I suggest that every student bring a drinking bottle.
lines.id: Aku paham. Aku menyarankan setiap siswa membawa botol minum.

lines.en: Great idea. Let's tell Ms. Sari about it.
lines.id: Ide bagus. Mari kita sampaikan kepada Ms. Sari.

lesson.title: Menulis recommendation yang kuat
lesson.text: Akhiri teks dengan saran yang **jelas dan bisa dilakukan**: siapa melakukan apa. Lebih baik [[Every student should bring a bottle.]] daripada [[We should do something.]] Gunakan [[Therefore]], [[So]], atau [[Let's]] di awal.

items: Hortatory exposition = meyakinkan pembaca bahwa sesuatu **seharusnya dilakukan**.
Modal: [[should]], [[ought to]], [[must]], [[had better]]; larangan: [[should not]], [[must not]].
Saran: [[I suggest that ...]], [[It is important to ...]], [[Let's ...]].
Beda dengan analytical: penutupnya **saran/ajakan**, bukan sekadar penegasan ulang.

Setiap hari, sekolah kita menghasilkan banyak sampah: botol plastik, bungkus makanan, dan kertas. Jika kita tidak mengelola sampah ini, sekolah kita akan kotor dan tidak sehat.
Karena itu, saya mengajak semua siswa untuk bertindak. Pertama, kita sebaiknya membuang sampah ke tempat yang benar. Kedua, kita sebaiknya membawa botol yang bisa dipakai ulang, bukan membeli yang baru. Ketiga, mari ikut program bersih-bersih Jumat bersama-sama. Jika kita bekerja sama, sekolah kita akan menjadi tempat belajar yang lebih bersih dan nyaman.

read.text:
Every day, our school produces a lot of waste: plastic bottles, food wrappers, and paper. If we do not manage this waste, our school will be dirty and unhealthy.
Therefore, I urge all students to take action. First, we should throw rubbish into the right bins. Second, we ought to bring reusable bottles instead of buying new ones. Third, let's join the Friday cleaning program together. If we work together, our school will become a cleaner and more comfortable place to learn.
read.title: Let's Keep Our School Clean

read.text:
Electricity is not cheap, and producing it often harms the environment. We can all help by saving energy at home. First, turn off the lights when you leave a room. Second, unplug chargers and devices that you are not using.
In addition, we should use fans instead of air conditioners whenever possible. Let us start today. Small actions, if done by many people, can make a big difference for our planet.
read.title: Save Energy at Home

read.id:
Hutan mangrove melindungi pantai kita dari ombak besar, dan menjadi rumah bagi banyak ikan dan burung. Sayangnya, banyak mangrove telah ditebang untuk dijadikan tambak. Jika kita tidak bertindak sekarang, pantai kita akan rusak.
Karena itu, kita sebaiknya menanam pohon mangrove baru setiap tahun. Pemerintah harus membuat aturan tegas, dan sekolah sebaiknya mengadakan hari menanam. Mari bergabung bersama untuk melindungi pantai kita. Tindakan kecil dapat membawa perubahan besar.

qs.exp: Teks: "protect our coast from big waves... home to many fish and birds".
options: They protect the coast and give homes to animals.
They make the sea warm and bring many tourists.
They produce salt that people sell at the market.
They bring tourists to the coast every single year.
qs.q: Why are mangroves important?

options: Mangroves will grow back by themselves.
Fish will increase along the coast.
Waves will stop before they reach the coast.
qs.q: What will happen if we do not act now?

options: Many mangroves have been cut down.
qs.q: Which expression is a call to action?
Pasangkan modal/ajakan dengan fungsinya:
Many mangroves ___ (cut) down.
If we don't act now, our coast ___ (damage).

qs.answer: The government must make strict rules.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Pemerintah harus membuat aturan tegas."

read.text:
Mangrove forests protect our coast from big waves, and they are home to many fish and birds. Unfortunately, many mangroves have been cut down to make fish ponds. If we do not act now, our coast will be damaged.
Therefore, we should plant new mangrove trees every year. The government must make strict rules, and schools ought to organize planting days. Let's join together to protect our coast. Small actions can make a big difference.
read.title: Let's Save the Mangroves

read.focus: Hortatory: conditional dan saran (If I were you...)
read.id:
Temanku Andi sering begadang bermain game, dan dia lelah di kelas. Aku berkata padanya, "Seandainya aku jadi kamu, aku akan tidur lebih awal. Kamu sebaiknya membuat batas waktu bermain game, dan sebaiknya menyimpan ponsel pukul sembilan."
"Jika kamu tidur nyenyak, kamu akan berkonsentrasi lebih baik," kataku. Andi tertawa, tetapi dia berjanji mencoba. Seminggu kemudian, dia berkata, "Seandainya aku mendengarkanmu lebih awal, aku pasti sudah lebih baik di ujian terakhir. Mari kita buat rencana belajar bersama."

qs.exp: Teks: "I would sleep earlier. You should set a time limit".
options: Sleep earlier and limit his games
Study all night and stop playing games
Stop going to school until he is rested
Buy a new phone with a time limit
qs.q: What does the writer advise Andi to do?

options: If I was you, I would sleeps earlier.
If I were you, I would sleep earlier.
You should set a time limit.
If you slept well, you would concentrate better.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

qs.exp: Teks: "If I had listened to you earlier, I would have done better".
options: He played too little and felt bored.
He slept too much on weekends.
qs.q: What does Andi regret?
Pasangkan ajakan atau saran dengan fungsinya:
If I ___ you, I would sleep earlier.
If I had listened earlier, I ___ (do) better.

qs.answer: You should set a time limit for your games.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Kamu sebaiknya membuat batas waktu bermain game."

read.text:
My friend Andi often stays up late playing games, and he is tired in class. I told him, "If I were you, I would sleep earlier. You should set a time limit for your games, and you ought to put your phone away at nine."
"If you slept well, you would concentrate better," I said. Andi laughed, but he promised to try. A week later, he said, "If I had listened to you earlier, I would have done better in the last test. Let's make a study plan together."
read.title: Advice to a Friend

read.focus: Should have, ought to have, dan saran
read.id:
Rani: Aku gagal kuis. Seharusnya aku belajar lebih banyak tadi malam. Dina: Seharusnya kamu meminta bantuanku. Aku akan menjelaskan rumusnya. Rani: Aku tahu. Seharusnya aku mendengarkan saranmu minggu lalu.
Dina: Jangan sedih. Mari buat rencana untuk ujian berikutnya. Kita sebaiknya bertemu setiap malam, dan harus menghindari gangguan. Rani: Ide bagus. Kali ini, aku tidak akan menunggu sampai hari terakhir. Aku akan mulai malam ini.

qs.q: Why does Rani feel bad?

options: I should have study more last night.
I should have studied more last night.
You ought to have asked me for help.
I would have explained the formulas.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

options: A plan that she will follow tomorrow
A rule that everyone must obey
A habit that she does every day
qs.q: What does "should have studied" show?

pairs: penyesalan atas tindakan yang tidak dilakukan
qs.q: Pasangkan bentuk dengan maknanya:
I ___ have studied more last night.
You ought to have ___ (ask) me for help.

qs.answer: I should have listened to your advice.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Seharusnya aku mendengarkan saranmu."

read.text:
Rani: I failed the quiz. I should have studied more last night. Dina: You ought to have asked me for help. I would have explained the formulas. Rani: I know. I should have listened to your advice last week.
Dina: Don't be sad. Let's make a plan for the next test. We should meet every evening, and we must avoid distractions. Rani: Good idea. This time, I won't wait until the last day. I'll start tonight.
read.title: Should Have Listened

read.focus: Preposisi ajakan: take part in, depend on, care about, protect from, join in
read.id:
Salma: Sungai kita kotor. Banyak orang bergantung padanya untuk air, jadi kita harus peduli padanya. Mari ikut serta dalam bersih-bersih hari Minggu. Dika: Di mana acaranya? Salma: Di jembatan, dari pukul tujuh sampai sepuluh. Semua orang bisa ikut.
Dika: Apa yang harus kita bawa? Salma: Bawa sarung tangan dan kantong. Kita harus melindungi sungai dari sampah plastik. Jika kita bekerja bersama, kita bisa bangga akan hasilnya. Dika: Aku ikut. Aku akan mengundang tetanggaku dan meminta mereka ikut bersama kita.

qs.exp: Salma: "At the bridge, from seven to ten."
qs.q: Where will the clean-up be held?

options: We must protect the river of plastic waste.
We must protect the river from plastic waste.
Many people depend on it for water.
Let's take part in the clean-up.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "We can be proud ___ the result."
Pasangkan frasa dengan artinya:
Many people depend ___ the river for water.
Let's take part ___ the clean-up on Sunday.

qs.answer: We must care about our river.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Kita harus peduli pada sungai kita."

read.text:
Salma: Our river is dirty. Many people depend on it for water, so we must care about it. Let's take part in the clean-up on Sunday. Dika: Where will it be held? Salma: At the bridge, from seven to ten. Everyone can join in.
Dika: What should we bring? Salma: Bring gloves and bags. We must protect the river from plastic waste. If we work together, we can be proud of the result. Dika: I'm in. I'll invite my neighbors and ask them to come with us.
read.title: Take Part!
